entries.title: Job 5:1
segments: Call now; is there any that will answer thee? And to which of the holy ones wilt thou turn?

entries.title: Job 5:2
segments: For vexation killeth the foolish man, And jealousy slayeth the silly one.

entries.title: Job 5:3
segments: I have seen the foolish taking root: But suddenly I cursed his habitation.

entries.title: Job 5:4
segments: His children are far from safety, And they are crushed in the gate, Neither is there any to deliver them:

entries.title: Job 5:5
segments: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, And taketh it even out of the thorns; And the snare gapeth for their substance.

entries.title: Job 5:6
segments: For affliction cometh not forth from the dust, Neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

entries.title: Job 5:7
segments: But man is born unto trouble, As the sparks fly upward.

entries.title: Job 5:8
segments: But as for me, I would seek unto God, And unto God would I commit my cause;

entries.title: Job 5:9
segments: Who doeth great things and unsearchable, Marvellous things without number:

entries.title: Job 5:10
segments: Who giveth rain upon the earth, And sendeth waters upon the fields;

entries.title: Job 5:11
segments: So that he setteth up on high those that are low, And those that mourn are exalted to safety.

entries.title: Job 5:12
segments: He frustrateth the devices of the crafty, So that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.

entries.title: Job 5:13
segments: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness; And the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

entries.title: Job 5:14
segments: They meet with darkness in the day-time, And grope at noonday as in the night.

entries.title: Job 5:15
segments: But he saveth from the sword of their mouth, Even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

entries.title: Job 5:16
segments: So the poor hath hope, And iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

entries.title: Job 5:17
segments: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: Therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 5:18
segments: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up; He woundeth, and his hands make whole.

entries.title: Job 5:19
segments: He will deliver thee in six troubles; Yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

entries.title: Job 5:20
segments: In famine he will redeem thee from death; And in war from the power of the sword.

entries.title: Job 5:21
segments: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue; Neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.

entries.title: Job 5:22
segments: At destruction and dearth thou shalt laugh; Neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

entries.title: Job 5:23
segments: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field; And the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

entries.title: Job 5:24
segments: And thou shalt know that thy tent is in peace; And thou shalt visit thy fold, and shalt miss nothing.

entries.title: Job 5:25
segments: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, And thine offspring as the grass of the earth.

entries.title: Job 5:26
segments: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, Like as a shock of grain cometh in in its season.

entries.title: Job 5:27
segments: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; Hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
